preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 400,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The input graph is a connected acyclic graph (a tree).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(x in (0, 1) for x in output_list)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all((output_list[i-1] == 1) == can_become_centroid(n, edges, i) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, the output is 1 if and only if it is possible to make vertex i a centroid by performing at most one edge replacement, and 0 otherwise.
